1.

We long, Lord, to see Thee soon In glory and splendour, That all the world may clearly behold Thy greatness and Thy power.

2.

When Thy triumph, Thy victory shall Be clearly manifest to all, And praise and homage be given to Him who is now despised.

3.

We know, and it is our joy, That God hath highly exalted Thee, But we long that Thou, highly uplifted, Shalt be revealed to every one.

4.

When every opposition is gone, And Thou alone art great, That then to Thee, beloved Lord, Shall be the desire of every soul.
